title: La lancha
goal: Get taken out on the lake by somebody who works it
culture: The isletas are three hundred and sixty-odd islands left by Mombacho falling into the lake. The tour boats leave from the Centro Turístico and charge in dollars; a fisherman at the shore will take you for córdobas and show you where he actually works. Agree the return before you go, or you will be negotiating it standing on an island.

beats.objective: Ask him to take you out
beats.en: Would you take me out to the isletas?
beats.good: Me lleva asks for the ride. He is not a tour operator and there is no ticket — there is a boat, a price and the two of you.
An hour gets you round the near islands and back. Settle the time before the price and the price will make sense.

beats.es: Va. ¿Y lo dejo allá o lo traigo de vuelta?
beats.good: Ida y vuelta — out and back. Agree it now. Agreeing it later means agreeing it while standing on an island.
Temprano, before the wind gets up on the lake in the afternoon. He will be there at six and so should you.
